description: One chapter (or margin note) of the guide as clean Markdown with its code blocks intact, or one section of it: with its outline, its code blocks listed separately, its FAQs, when it last changed, and the official docs.databricks.com links it cites for the authoritative detail.

section.description: One section only: its anchor (from search_guide, list_chapters or the outline) or its heading. Omit for the whole chapter.

slug.description: A chapter's slug (lakebase, unity-catalog, start-here), a note's slug, or a guide URL or path. list_chapters has them; the field-guide-chapter prompt completes them.

name: get_chapter

build.description: The commit of the deploy that answered

index_built.description: When this deploy's index was built (ISO 8601)

markdown.description: The chapter or section as Markdown, code blocks intact; links are absolute

next.description: When this is about a concept the guide explains interactively: the call for a step-by-step walkthrough

ttlMs.description: How long this answer may be kept before asking again, in milliseconds

updated.description: When the page last changed, YYYY-MM-DD

title: Read a chapter
